1392388515019862016.a: Making custom dipoles from coax using a cheapy 1-3000 MHz RF vector network analyzer. Wifi antennas often have removable radomes; gently wiggle off the radome and replace. This TP Link has each dipole split across two sides of a PCB with matching network at the top of the first. t.co

1392388516538208256.a: Repurposing WiFi antennas makes for a really nice looking antenna for your SDRs and test equipment. It also disguises your custom antenna as a wifi antenna if that is somehow useful. The homebrew antenna is just coax with the halves separated and trimmed to the frequency desired.
